# Race, Ethnicity, and Partiality Claim Audit

**Lesson:** T4-L16 - Race, Ethnicity, and Partiality

## Purpose

Support the primary activity for Race, Ethnicity, and Partiality.

## Instructions

1. Read the principal passage.
2. Record direct observations.
3. Separate interpretation from application.
4. Name one faithful response.

## Text

Acts 10:34-35; Galatians 3:26-29; James 2:1-13

## Big idea

The gospel rejects ethnic superiority and partiality while forming a multi-ethnic people in Christ.

## Guardrails

Reject ethnic superiority and partiality without pretending all historical or structural questions are resolved by one proof text. | Do not pressure minority students to educate the class from personal experience.
